_note: Strings for /onboard/channels and the per-channel publish rows. Channel names are proper nouns and stay in Latin script in every language — an artisan looking for the Amazon app on their phone is looking for the word on the icon, and a transliteration they cannot match to anything on screen is worse than the untranslated name. Odia is absent on purpose; add `or` only after a native speaker has checked it.
